title: Cheesy Tteok Mexican Casserole
description: A fusion twist on traditional Mexican casseroles, incorporating Korean tteok and creamy cheesy goodness.
instructions: Cook the tteok according to package instructions, then set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the shredded chicken with cumin and Mexican seasoning until lightly browned.
In a separate pot, heat the salsa with a pinch of Korean chili flakes (if using) until warm.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked tteok, sour cream, and shredded cheese. Mix until well combined.
Add the cooked chicken mixture to the tteok mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Drizzle the warmed salsa over the top and bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cumin or Korean chili flakes if desired.
